contexts.text: When the Lord resuscitates into life, or regenerates, man...
How it is with man when he is being resuscitated...
On the resuscitation of man from the dead. General article. SE 300. SE 1092.
The things which happen to those who are being resuscitated. Described. AC 170-181. HH 449.
The man thus resuscitated by the celestial Angels is as yet in an obscure life.
Continuation: on the entrance of a resuscitated one into eternal life. General article.

When Celestial Angels are with a resuscitated one, they do not leave him... Spiritual Angels (then) approach and give him the use of light, for until now he has seen nothing, but has only thought. (Their action described. AC 183-185). HH 450.
[The resuscitated one] then sets out in life; which at first is happy and glad...
He is (at first) among Angels, and so appears to himself to be in the flower of early manhood.

After the use of light is given to the resuscitated one... the spiritual Angels render him all kindly services... and instruct him... so far as he can apprehend; and, if he has been in faith, and longs for it, they show him the wonderful and magnificent things of Heaven.
But if the rescuscitated one, or Soul, does not want to be instructed, he desires to be out of the company of Angels. (His further course described. AC 316-319. AC 2119.)
When the celestial Angels are with the corpse of a dead man, who is to be resuscitated...
Under Resurrection, see this reference. AC 2813:3. AE 899:11.
All infants who die are resuscitated by the Lord...
A choir of Gentiles who had been resuscitated three or four days...
Those resuscitated after death... see represented to them a young man sitting on a horse... Explained.
Burial = resuscitation.
The resuscitation of the Spiritual Church by the Lord. Treated of.
See Resuscitate.
That they would thus emerge from night and be resuscitated into life. Signified. AC 2925. AC 2948. AC 2961.
Without hope of resuscitation (of the Church). Signified.
Sepulchre = resurrection and regeneration, thus resuscitation, namely, of the Church.
That sepulchre = resuscitation, Explained.
(The resuscitation of a dead man would not have convinced them.)
If they are told that it is the interior man... who is resuscitated by the Lord when the body dies... they cannot apprehend.
That the Church is to be resuscitated. Signified, Explained.
The resuscitation of the Church by the Internal. Signified. AC 6519.
To resuscitate the Church. Signified.
When a new Church is resuscitated, on the perishing of the old one. Signified.
On the resuscitation of man from the dead. Chapter.

After the separation, the spirit remains a short time in the body, but no longer than until the total cessation of the heart, which takes place with variety according to the state of disease from which the man dies; for with some the motion of the heart lasts long, and with some not long. As soon as this motion ceases, the man is resuscitated; but this is done by the Lord alone. By resuscitation is meant the drawing out of the man's spirit from the body, and its introduction into the Spiritual World, which is commonly called the resurrection. Explained.
The spirit of man... first enters the World of Spirits... shortly after his resuscitation. (His first state there, described.)
That they were resuscitated = that those became alive who otherwise would have spiritually perished.
Saying unto me, Fear not = resuscitation. Explained.
This love... will be resuscitated, because it is resuscitable.
Occurs.
The Knowledges they had... are easily resuscitated.
When they resuscitate this in themselves (there). SE 2812.
On the resuscitated who were spiritually dead.
[The idea] was resuscitated that...
To teach Spirits to resuscitate them, also the dead.
On a certain rescuscitated woman.

On those who are resuscitated from the dead. (Brahe) was decapitated at 10 a.m., and was seen, and spoke with me at 10 p.m., thus twelve hours after, and afterwards continually for some days. After two days he began to return to his previous state of life... and after three days he became as he had been in the world...

On the resuscitation of the dead. Twice or thrice I was let into a place where there is the resurrection of the dead... It is known from the fact that something balsamic is perceived from the corpses when the Lord and the celestial Angels are present... The Lord is especially present there, and therefore celestial Angels are there; for, without such presence of the Lord, there would be no resuscitation of the dead.

Concerning one who was resuscitated shortly after death... Polhem died on Monday, and spoke with me on Thursday... He heard when the priest said that he would be resuscitated at the Last Judgment, when yet he had already been resuscitated...
As burial = both resuscitation into life, and regeneration...
The resuscitation of plants from ashes, a type.
